description: Tax & Commercial Billing Web App replicating INV-000155.pdf layout with LocalStorage persistence, GST/Tax calculations, Indian Rupee words converter, dynamic UPI QR code, print/PDF export, and GitHub Pages deployment.

userStories.title: Create LocalStorage state management and default data schema
userStories.description: As a user, I want my invoices, business profile, customers, and product catalogs to persist in localStorage so I don't lose data on page reload.
acceptanceCriteria: Create storage.js with methods: getInvoices, saveInvoice, deleteInvoice, getSettings, saveSettings, getItems, saveItem, getCustomers, saveCustomer
Initialize default business profile with details from INV-000155 (Vikas Digital Signature Shop, Gursahaiganj, UP 209722, Phone 7392045049, itisvikasprajapati@gmail.com)
Seed default invoice INV-000155 with Bharat Singh as customer and DSC Certificate + DSC Token items
Provide JSON export and import capabilities for data backup and restoration
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement Indian currency number-to-words converter
userStories.description: As an accountant/business owner, I want invoice totals to automatically convert into Indian Rupees in words (Lakhs/Crores format) as seen in INV-000155.pdf.
acceptanceCriteria: Create number-to-words.js with function convertNumberToIndianWords(amount)
Correctly converts 2500.00 into 'Indian Rupee Two Thousand Five Hundred Only'
Handles single digits, tens, hundreds, thousands, lakhs, and crores
Supports decimal paise conversion when amount has fractional paise
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement UPI QR code generator for instant payment
userStories.description: As a merchant, I want a dynamic UPI QR code rendered on the invoice so customers can scan with PhonePe, Google Pay, or Paytm to pay the balance due.
acceptanceCriteria: Create qr.js using qrcode-generator or standalone canvas-based QR renderer
Generates upi://pay?pa={upiId}&pn={businessName}&am={balanceDue}&cu=INR&tn={invoiceNo}
Updates dynamically when balance due or invoice number changes
Toggle option in settings to show or hide UPI QR code on the printed invoice
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build pixel-perfect invoice template replicating INV-000155.pdf
userStories.description: As a user, I want the printed and previewed invoice to mirror the layout of INV-000155.pdf exactly, including the header, dark table headers, totals block, and Original/Duplicate badges.
acceptanceCriteria: Create invoice-template.js rendering the exact layout of INV-000155.pdf
Includes Business header with name, address, phone, and email
Includes TAX INVOICE title, # INV-000155, Balance Due widget, Bill To section, and Invoice/Due dates
Line items table matches PDF styling (#, Item & Description, Qty, Rate, Amount)
Includes Sub Total, Total, Payment Made (-), Balance Due shaded row, and Total In Words
Includes Notes ('Thanks for your business.') and Authorized Signature area
Includes toggle for ORIGINAL / DUPLICATE copies
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Build interactive invoice editor and management dashboard UI
userStories.description: As a user, I want an intuitive dashboard where I can edit invoices, add line items, calculate taxes, record payments, and view invoice history.
acceptanceCriteria: Create responsive layout with Invoice Editor, Live Preview panel, and Invoices List tab
Add, edit, remove line items with automatic subtotal, tax (GST/CGST/SGST/IGST), discount, and balance due calculations
Save invoice, create new invoice, duplicate existing invoice, and delete invoice
Status badges: Paid, Partial, Unpaid
Customer autocomplete / quick-select from saved customers
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implemented in index.html, js/app.js, and css/styles.css

userStories.title: Implement print-to-PDF and direct PDF download functionality
userStories.description: As a user, I want to print or save the invoice as an A4 PDF with clean typography, proper page margins, and zero UI clutter.
acceptanceCriteria: Add @media print styles that hide buttons, navigation, and sidebar, isolating only the A4 invoice sheet
Support 1-click browser Print dialog (Ctrl+P or Print button)
Support direct PDF download using HTML5 canvas / print renderer
Options to print ORIGINAL copy, DUPLICATE copy, or both pages consecutively like the source PDF
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Configure GitHub Pages deployment and documentation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want this app to be 100% compatible with GitHub Pages with zero build step and include an automated GitHub Actions deployment workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: All asset references in index.html and JS use relative paths (./) for subdirectory hosting
Create .github/workflows/deploy.yml for GitHub Pages automated deployment
Create comprehensive README.md with live demo setup, features, and deployment instructions
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Configured relative paths, workflow, and README.md
